newsitems.title: The Witcher IV — Cinematic Reveal Trailer
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents: We're thrilled to reveal the first look at The Witcher IV! The Witcher IV will be a single-player open-world RPG. It marks the beginning of a new saga with Ciri as a protagonist, embarking on her own journey to become a professional monster slayer. The trailer was produced in cooperation with Platig...
